title: Spine-panel lettering contract: Cockerell rules as CSS/SVG constraints
purpose: Integration contract mapping Cockerell's bookbinding lettering rules (art_01M6QDBQN448XJGKMPFN7C85ES r1, lines 3818–3924) to a CSS/SVG spine-panel layout system. Each rule becomes an explicit interface with stated assumptions and known gaps. Usable as an audit layer for digital spine-label generators or print-on-demand cover tools.
